partners.mechanism_chain: SLC25A13 (HGNC:10983) —DISRUPTS→ Aspartate transport into mitochondria (REACT:R-HSA-195888); Aspartate transport into mitochondria (REACT:R-HSA-195888) —DECREASES→ Aspartate (CHEBI:17000); Aspartate (CHEBI:17000) —DECREASES→ Citrin (CHEBI:17605); Citrin (CHEBI:17605) —DISRUPTS→ Urea cycle (REACT:R-HSA-180945); Urea cycle (REACT:R-HSA-180945) —LEADS_TO→ Cholestasis (HP:0001395); Urea cycle (REACT:R-HSA-180945) —LEADS_TO→ Failure to thrive (HP:0011344); Urea cycle (REACT:R-HSA-180945) —LEADS_TO→ Jaundice (HP:0000952); Urea cycle (REACT:R-HSA-180945) —LEADS_TO→ Hepatomegaly (HP:0002295).
